options.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome to Camp Snooze! 🏕️

Congratulations on signing up to our most transformative support experience. Here is a couple of things we need you to do before camp begins:

1. Download the Kajabi App for the Best Camp Experience


If you haven't done so already, did you know you can access all your Snooze resources on-the-go with the Kajabi app?:

📱 Download for iOS

📱 Download for Android

Once downloaded, log in with your email and password to access all your Snooze content.

2. Complete Your Camp Snooze Intake Form IMPORTANT

Please complete your intake form as soon as possible. Sally and Bec use this information to create your personalised sleep plan for camp.

Complete Your Intake Form →

https://forms.gle/JxzVuV4LBdjRvkZf6

3. What Happens Next for Camp Snooze

  • A couple of days before camp: You'll receive your packing list and custom sleep plan
  • Before camp starts: Inside the Snooze Village, you'll get access to the private Camp Snooze channel for your intake
  • When camp begins: Join the live calls And get dedicated support as you implement your plan
  • Each morning during camp: Daily roll call at 10-11am AEDT / 8-9pm ET (recordings available)

Questions?
The best way to get specific questions answered is to email sally@joinsnooze.com. We're here to help.

See you at camp roll call! 🏕️

Sally + Bec
